# Core dependencies for the data foundation (Phase 1.0).
# Exact installed versions are frozen into every run manifest (see src/common/manifest.py);
# this file pins the compatible ranges. Phase-specific packages are added as those phases begin,
# not up front.

# --- Tabular / numeric ---
polars>=1.0,<2.0
pyarrow>=15.0          # parquet backend for polars I/O
numpy>=1.26,<3.0

# --- Config / IO ---
pyyaml>=6.0
requests>=2.31

# --- Indian market data sources (all free) ---
yfinance>=0.2.40       # cross-check source, .NS tickers
jugaad-data>=0.26      # NSE bhavcopy archives + corporate actions
nsepython>=2.9         # index membership / fallback lookups

# --- Regime labelling (Phase 2.0) ---
# Gaussian HMM. NOTE: only the *fitting* half of this library is used. `predict` (Viterbi over the
# whole sequence) and `predict_proba` (smoothed posteriors) both decide the state at session t using
# observations after t, which is exactly the leakage P2 is built to avoid. Labels come from a
# forward-only recursion implemented in src/stress/regimes.py. See DECISIONS.md, Phase 2.0.
hmmlearn>=0.3,<0.4
scikit-learn>=1.4        # hmmlearn dependency; pinned here so it appears in the manifest
scipy>=1.11              # triangular solve in the filtered decode; imported directly, so pinned

# --- Dev tooling ---
ruff>=0.6
mypy>=1.10
pytest>=8.0
types-PyYAML>=6.0    # stubs so mypy can check the config loader
